# Scott Froidl


Co-Head of Manager Research


As Co-Head of Manager Research, Scott is a voting member of the LPL Financial Strategic and Tactical Asset Allocation Committee (STAAC) and voting member of the Investment Manager Committee (IMC). He is also a voting member of the Tactical Model Committee and OMP Manager Performance Committee (MPC). Scott is the leader of the equity product research team and covers U.S. large cap equity managers, derivative income managers, and is a key contributor to the LPL Research centrally managed portfolios.


## Prior to joining LPL Financial


Prior to joining LPL Financial in 2021, Scott performed investment analysis with the Wells Fargo Investment Institute and Stifel. He began his career as a financial advisor at Prudential Securities in 1995.


## Education & Achievements


BS in Sales and Marketing, Lindenwood University.


Current board member of the CFA St. Louis Society.


Series 7, 63, and 65 licenses
